AMP.1: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,
AMP.2:
"How long will you hunt for words and continue these speeches?
Do some clear thinking and show understanding and then we can talk.
AMP.3:
"Why are we regarded as beasts,
As if [we are] stupid (senseless) in your eyes?
AMP.4:
"You who tear yourself apart in anger,
Is the earth to be abandoned for your sake,
Or the rock to be moved out of its place?
AMP.5:
"Indeed, the light of the wicked will be put out,
And the flame of his fire will not shine.
AMP.6:
"The light will be dark in his tent,
And his lamp beside him will be put out.
AMP.7:
"The vigorous stride will be shortened,
And his own counsel and the scheme [in which he trusted] will bring his downfall.
AMP.8:
"For the wicked is thrown into a net by his own feet (wickedness),
And he steps on the webbing [of the lattice-covered pit].
AMP.9:
"A snare catches him by the heel,
And a trap snaps shut on him.
AMP.10:
"A noose is hidden for him on the ground,
And a trap for him on the path.
AMP.11:
"Terrors frighten him on every side
And chase at his heels.
AMP.12:
"The strength [of the wicked] is famished and weakened,
And disaster is ready at his side [if he stops].
AMP.13:
"His skin is devoured by disease;
The firstborn of death [the worst of diseases] consumes his limbs.
AMP.14:
"He is torn from his tent which he trusted [for safety],
And he is marched and brought to the king of terrors (death).
AMP.15:
"Nothing of his dwells in his tent;
Brimstone (burning sulfur) is scattered over his dwelling [to purify it].
AMP.16:
"The roots [of the wicked] are dried up below,
And above, his branch is cut off and withers.
AMP.17:
"Memory of him perishes from the earth,
And he has no name on the street.
AMP.18:
"He is driven and propelled from light into darkness,
And chased from the inhabited world.
AMP.19:
"He has no offspring or prosperity among his people,
Nor any survivor where he sojourned.
AMP.20:
"Those in the west are astonished and appalled at his fate,
And those in the east are seized with horror.
AMP.21:
"Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked and the ungodly,
And such is the place of him who does not know or recognize or honor God."

“Surely the light of the wicked will be snuffed out.

MSG.2:
"How monotonous these word games are getting!
Get serious! We need to get down to business.
MSG.3:
Why do you treat your friends like slow-witted animals?
You look down on us as if we don't know anything.
MSG.4:
Why are you working yourself up like this?
Do you want the world redesigned to suit you?
Should reality be suspended to accommodate you?
MSG.5:
"Here's the rule: The light of the wicked is put out.
Their flame dies down and is extinguished.
MSG.6:
Their house goes dark—
every lamp in the place goes out.
MSG.7:
Their strong strides weaken, falter;
they stumble into their own traps.
MSG.8:
They get all tangled up
in their own red tape,
MSG.9:
Their feet are grabbed and caught,
their necks in a noose.
MSG.10:
They trip on ropes they've hidden,
and fall into pits they've dug themselves.
MSG.11:
Terrors come at them from all sides.
They run helter-skelter.
MSG.12:
The hungry grave is ready
to gobble them up for supper,
MSG.13:
To lay them out for a gourmet meal,
a treat for ravenous Death.
MSG.14:
They are snatched from their home sweet home
and marched straight to the death house.
MSG.15:
Their lives go up in smoke;
acid rain soaks their ruins.
MSG.16:
Their roots rot
and their branches wither.
MSG.17:
They'll never again be remembered—
nameless in unmarked graves.
MSG.18:
They are plunged from light into darkness,
banished from the world.
MSG.19:
And they leave empty-handed—not one single child—
nothing to show for their life on this earth.
MSG.20:
Westerners are aghast at their fate,
easterners are horrified:
MSG.21:
'Oh no! So this is what happens to perverse people.
This is how the God-ignorant end up!' "
